extension.summary: Share Stream Cinema preferences and viewing history through private Kra storage.
extension.description: Synchronize viewing history, language, subtitle appearance, interface sounds, common addon preferences and portable Amber appearance. Save captured core preferences before acknowledging them. Hide subtitles with Czech audio, otherwise prefer Czech then English. Keep credentials, hardware and paths local.
extension.news: 0.1.3: Share common interface, regional, subtitle and addon preferences. Persist captured core settings before acknowledging them. Hide subtitles with Czech audio; otherwise prefer Czech, then English. Hardware, credentials and paths stay local.
